title: Does Layered Oversight Cancel or Compound Correlated Errors?

original_idea.body:
# Does Layered Oversight Cancel or Compound Correlated Errors?

**Problem:** Whether stacking independent vs correlated weak judges helps is untested cheaply.

**Direction:** Simulate a 2-3 layer oversight chain with small open judges. One condition shares a bias (same family/prompt); another deliberately diversifies. Measure whether the chain's final accuracy improves only when errors are decorrelated.

**Why it matters:** Tells facilitators whether more oversight layers helps at all.

**Relevant context:** Anthropic agenda; arXiv:2510.11235; Kenton et al. (2024).
